title: CompletedMatchingRingMapTorsionKernel
statement: Let A be a Noetherian commutative local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], m its maximal ideal, C its m-adic completion, U the complement of the closed point in Spec A, q:Y to U finite, s:E to Spec C finite [def-weil-finite-integral-morphism], and D a completion overlap identification [def-sbc-punctured-completion-matching-sections]. Let P be the ring pushout of the matching ring and C over A, and let psi:P to Gamma(E) be [def-sbc-completed-matching-ring-map]. Write i:A to P for the structural map through the matching ring. For every x in P and natural number n, if i(a)*x=0 for every a in m^n and psi(x)=0, then x=0.

proof.text: Set m to the maximal ideal, C to its adic completion and B to D.matchingRing. Mathlib proves completion flatness, equality of its maximal ideal with mC and bijectivity on residue fields. Ideal.quotientMap_injective' and residue-field surjectivity prove that A/m to C/mC is bijective. The Noetherian hypothesis makes m finitely generated.

The private pushout_torsion_descends helper transports Ideal.primaryComponent_baseChange_bijective through CommRingCat.isPushout_tensorProduct, respecting the structural A-action. It gives x = inl(b) for b in B annihilated by m^k, with k allowed to differ from n.
By the pushout inl-desc identity for completedRingMap, its value on inl(b) is the second matching projection of b. The kernel hypothesis therefore makes that projection zero.

Project baseMap to the first matching coordinate. Its value is the structural map A to Gamma(Y). For every y of Y its image prime lies in U and differs from the unique maximal ideal. Choose a in m outside that prime, using containment of every proper ideal in the maximal ideal. By Scheme.preimage_basicOpen_top and basicOpen_eq_of_affine, y lies in the basic open of the structural image of a. Since a^k belongs to m^k, germ_eq_zero_of_pow_mul_eq_zero makes the germ of the first coordinate of b zero. TopCat.Presheaf.section_ext makes this coordinate zero. This argument needs neither finite q nor an affine cover.

The matching ring is the ring pullback. Concrete.isLimit_ext for pullbackIsPullback identifies elements whose two projections agree; the overlap projection agrees as a composite of the first projection. Thus b=0, and x=inl(b)=0. Empty Y, exponent zero and zero component rings are included without additional hypotheses.

proof_origin.place: Tags 05EC (1), 05ER and 0BLH; same torsion kernel route, with pointwise stalk vanishing in place of an affine basic-open cover

lean.statement:
theorem completedRingMap_torsion_kernel_zero
    {A : Type u} [CommRing A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A]
    {U : (Spec (.of A)).Opens}
    (hU : ∀ x : Spec (.of A), x ∈ U ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint A)
    {Y : Scheme.{u}} {q : Y ⟶ U.toScheme} [IsFinite q]
    {E : Scheme.{u}} {s : E ⟶ Spec
      (.of (AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A))} [IsFinite s]
    (D : CompletionGluingData A U q E s) :
    ∀ x (n : ℕ),
      (∀ a ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A ^ n,
        (D.baseMap ≫ pushout.inl _ _).hom a * x = 0) →
      D.completedRingMap x = 0 → x = 0
